title: Processing Types
description: Shared types for the dataQuality, processing and signalJourney extensions. A library of $defs; the root constrains nothing.

recipeId.description: Identifier of a NEMAR processing recipe (for example nemar-floor), lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

version.description: A version label (recipe, dataset or plugin version) of letters, digits and . _ + -.

sha256.description: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest of a file's bytes.

checkpointName.description: Name of a processing checkpoint: a coarse stage a recipe declares. Open vocabulary; the writer checks it against the checkpoints the recipe version declares.

stepId.description: Identifier of a recipe step (the step names of a recipe's step order).

failureCode.description: Machine-readable failure or skip code, lowercase snake case.

metricName.description: Name of a quality metric. Safe as a document key (no . or $); allows namespaced names such as eeg:lineNoise. Naming rules live in signalJourney's nemar namespace.

relativeLocation.description: Relative POSIX path inside a run's product: no leading slash, no .. segment, no URI scheme, no backslash, no control characters.

inputKind.description: What a run read: a BIDS dataset directory or NEMAR's Zarr serving copy.

profile.description: Which copy of the data a run's results describe: the archived recordings or the serving copy.

inputProfilePairing.description: A zarr input always describes the serving copy and a bids input the archive.

range.description: A closed numeric range; either end may be null when unbounded or unknown.

plugin.description: The quality plugin, by name and version, that produced a value or figure.

name.description: Plugin name as declared in its manifest.

version.description: Plugin version as declared in its manifest.
